invariants.title: The line is heard
invariants.rule: "Fine. Run, then." - both words, low and rough.
invariants.why: He lets her go; the film's last spoken words.

invariants.title: His face barely moves
invariants.why: He has lost, and will not show it.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.why: It is his shot; the frame stays on him.

flair.title: Dust
flair.note: settling on his coat and beard

title: fine
beat: Hale, dust on his coat, stares at the wall and says, quietly: "Fine. Run, then."
